podcasts.name: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Post-Sugar Baby Doll Collaboration
podcast.body: After Sugar Baby Doll broke up in late 1985, Courtney Love and Cat Bjelland stayed together to form a new group called Pagan Babies. This band was another "pre-Riot Grrrl band" and, despite its brief existence, represents a link in the early collaborations of these influential musicians. "But when the band broke up in late 1985, Courtney and Cat stayed together long enough to be in a new group called Pagan Babies."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Riot Grrrl Band
podcast.body: Pagan Babies is mentioned as one of the bands within the Riot Grrrl movement. "And then there were bands like Sugar Baby Doll and the Pagan Babies and Brat Mobio and Heaven's De Betsy and Huggy Bear."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Driven By Her: Women Who Rocked The 90's

xref.title: No Surviving Official Recordings
xref.body: Despite word spreading about the kind of music Sugar Baby Doll was attempting to create, there appear to be no surviving official recordings of the band. However, some material from Pagan Babies, formed by Courtney Love and Cat Bjelland after Sugar Baby Doll's demise, might have been part of their live sets. "Like I said, there doesn't seem to be any surviving official Sugar Baby Doll recordings."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
